reviewed_assertions: tests/test_drain_week_view.py:62 checks only the fixture length; no production-code change can make it fail, so it is not counted as a regression guard.

tests/test_drain_week_view.py:88-100 and :104-122 use independent literal phase and held-reason counts; they fail if the summarizer collapses buckets, misattributes plans, or changes these fixture counts.

tests/test_drain_week_view.py:101-103, :113-114 and :124 use literal recent launch, landing and estimate values; they fail if the coded arithmetic for the populated timestamps changes, but the landed fixture has no dispatched_at and cannot catch queue-time substitution.

tests/test_drain_week_view.py:125-127 compares against the later literal verdict and fails if the earlier verdict replaces it; it does not assert that healthy awaiting-upstream requests are absent from stuck.
tests/test_drain_week_view.py:134 fails if a zero landing rate produces a numeric estimate instead of null.
tests/test_drain_week_view.py:148 and :150 fail if the MCP result loses the 500 queued requests or its measured read takes at least 30 seconds.
